source.commit_scope: Application implementation is pinned by application_code_commit. Windows-release-validation.json identifies the exact release tag/build commit and final checks.

ki_library.scope: Bundled 127 scientific KIs and 2 observation data KIs retain the prior release snapshot. Updated desktop/shared-flow code is pinned by source.application_code_commit. Downloaded Library updates and local KDT-approved repairs are separate; the DSSAT acceptance used those separate revisions.

changes.summary: Run project work in a supervised WSL Linux runtime (named-user transport, sidecar service, runtime provenance, native dependency gates); the Windows package ships the sidecar's Linux-readable source.

Bind the selected interpreter and helper revision, separate fresh from retained setups, keep KI repair lineage and project setup repair consistent, add SHAW and EPANET maintenance recipes, and write Windows state files safely under brief sharing errors.
Require current successful receipts for declared upstream producers, validate native NetCDF outputs and keep failed history out of the current attempt.
Resolve a recipe's Git ref tag-first so a release tag is never replaced by a same-named branch (WRF-Hydro v5.2.0 versus the stale v5.2.0-beta3 branch).

Run up to three KI repair passes with host-regenerated projections, the draft's own tests on an isolated copy and KDT; return test output, KDT failures, portability refusals and blocking doctor findings to the author.
Name every offending file and accept distribution-owned Linux paths in install documentation; per-machine paths stay rejected.

When a KI is installed into a project, map server-root paths built in code (model/, python_env/, data/obs, data/soil, outputs/ ...) through the server layout table to desktop roles; SHAW and WOFOST excluded.

platform_notes.windows: Windows x64 only. Python is included; AI providers and scientific models are configured or installed separately. Browser frontend and tray exit are retained. The WSL Linux runtime needs a user-installed WSL Ubuntu distribution and a named Linux user.
platform_notes.macos: This release does not replace the macOS application assets.
platform_notes.linux: This release does not replace the Linux application assets.

validation.release_checks: Final source, packaged-runtime, installer lifecycle and asset hashes are recorded in Windows-release-validation.json and attached JUnit reports.

prior_gui_acceptance.scope: Existing installed runtime and separately KDT-approved local repair; no bundled-KI, new-site, calibration, or all-model claim.

limits: The bundled KI library is unchanged from 0.6.60; KI repairs verified in individual projects (for example WRF-Hydro's Ubuntu 24.04 install guide and calibration adapter) are not bundled.
The Linux backend keeps a copy of each rejected KI library update and does not remove old staged application copies; WSL disk use grows until cleaned manually.
Server home-directory datasets and toolchains referenced by 20 KIs, and a few machine-specific paths (CaMa_Flood, VIC, Noah_MP), still need per-KI repair.
Live provider coverage beyond the recorded DeepSeek GUI cases was not retested for this release.
Native macOS/Linux application testing is outside this Windows release.

recent_gui_acceptance.scope: Fresh Python 3.12.10 environment and PCSE 6.0.12 with two project-local KDT-approved KI repairs; no bundled-KI, calibration or all-model claim.

agent_update_protocol: Read release-manifest.json before changing an installation.
Compare product version, source.code_commit and source.release_tag for application changes.
Compare ki_library.source_commit and windows_overlay_commit for bundled KI changes.
Preserve user settings, API keys, proxy choices, projects, data and recorded model installation paths.
Verify the downloaded Windows asset against SHA256SUMS-Windows.txt.
Report the applied change IDs and any migration or retry action to the user.

guides.scope: Unchanged reviewed 0.6.55 PDF/HTML edition, including illustrated three-page quickstarts in English and Chinese, bundled with Windows 0.6.61.
